title: Reinstatement Terms of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers by Instrument
content:
The figures that govern reinstatement of an expired credit are fixed per instrument of **Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers**: whether reinstatement is permitted, the calendar days after the expiry date during which it may be requested, the fee per reinstatement, the reinstated validity in calendar months, and the most reinstatements one credit may receive.

## The figures

| Instrument | Reinstatement permitted | Request window (calendar days after expiry) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Reinstated validity months | Most reinstatements per credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Flight Credit | Yes | 90 | 150 | 6 | 1 |
| Crestline Trip Credit | Yes | 90 | 150 | 6 | 1 |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | Yes | 30 | 0 | 3 | 1 |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Questions answered by the table

**Which instruments may be reinstated after expiry?**
The Crestline Flight Credit, the Crestline Trip Credit and the Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate. The Crestline Residual Travel Credit, the Crestline Disruption Voucher and the Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher may not.

**How long after expiry may reinstatement be requested?**
90 calendar days for the Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit, and 30 calendar days for the Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate.

**What is the instrument's reinstatement fee?**
150 US dollars for the Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit, and 0 for the Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate.

**What are the instrument's reinstated validity months?**
6 calendar months for the Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit, and 3 for the Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate. This is the instrument's figure for validity counted from the reinstatement date.

**How many times may one credit be reinstated?**
At most 1 time on each of the three instruments that permit it.
